generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The agency or bidder must possess a designated laboratory that is authorized or accredited, or recognized by the Government of Karnataka to conduct medical examinations for workers employed in factories. As a proof, the bidder is required to upload the authorization certificate issued by the Government of Karnataka.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The agency should furnish necessary documentary proof for having carried out the above works such as Work order (single or multiple not more than two in any one financial year) value not less than 1.3 Lakhs per year in the preceding 5 financial years. Work done value for previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the current financial year in which the tender is invited.

Bidder should have proven financial capability and have an annual turnover of Rs.2.6 Lakhs in any two years of preceding 5 financial years. As a proof the bidder shall furnish copy of profit and loss statement/audited balance sheet duly certified by Chartered Accountant in e-tender. Financial Turnover of previous five financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the current financial year in which the tender is invited.

itemList.description: Annual Medical Examination of Employee; It includes 1. Complete blood picture 2. Random blood sugar 3. Urine routine 4. ECG 5. Chest x-ray for workers working in dust prone areas (optional) 6. Pulmonary Function Test 7. Audiometry 8. Vision Test (Near Vision,Distant Vision, Colour Blindness) 9. Serum Creatinine 10. General Physical Examination 11.Form-16 duly certified by the certifying surgeon/competent authority
